proxy.for_services.tip: WinHTTP proxy — for services and some programs
proxy.list.title: My proxies
proxy.list.empty: Empty. Add a proxy below, for example: Clash Verge — 127.0.0.1:7897.
proxy.form.title: Add or edit
proxy.form.name: Name
proxy.form.pac.tip: Optional. A link starting with http:// or https://
proxy.apply.title: Apply to
proxy.for_user_admin.tip: Asks for administrator rights — if it cannot be changed without the helper
proxy.for_machine_admin.tip: Will apply to all users of the PC
proxy.also_winhttp.tip: WinHTTP proxy — for services and programs that do not read the system proxy
proxy.disable.tip: Turn off the system proxy; the previous one will be remembered
proxy.confirm.machine: Proxy for all users of this computer{services}: {line}. To undo: “Turn off proxy” or “Settings” → “DpiShell changes”. Turn on?
proxy.confirm.machine_restore: Restore the previous proxy for all users of this computer: {line}?
proxy.check.tip: Connect to two sites through the selected proxy
proxy.hints.title: Good to know
proxy.note.machine_wide: A policy is in effect: Windows uses machine-wide settings; user settings have no effect.
proxy.note.policy_blocked: The proxy is locked by a policy (usually by an organization administrator): changes may not apply or may be reverted.
proxy.say.policy_suffix: {message} A machine-wide policy is in effect: it will not work for a single user — choose “For the whole PC”.
proxy.old_helper: The helper is outdated and cannot change the proxy — update it on the “About & updates” tab.
proxy.err.need_helper_user: The helper is required — the proxy cannot be changed with administrator rights without it.
proxy.err.need_helper_machine: The helper is required — the proxy of the whole PC cannot be changed without it.
proxy.form.err.name: The name — 1 to 40 characters.
proxy.form.err.no_server: Enter the proxy address, for example 127.0.0.1:7897.
proxy.problem.server: Proxy address — in the form host:port, for example 127.0.0.1:7897 (or http=host:port;https=host:port).
proxy.problem.bypass: Exclusions — names and masks separated by “;”, for example <local>;*.example.com.
proxy.problem.pac: Auto-config address — a link starting with http:// or https://.
proxy.problem.empty: Enter a proxy address or an auto-config address.
proxy.hint.browsers: Browsers usually use the system proxy; Firefox uses its own setting.
proxy.hint.own_proxy: Programs with their own proxy (messengers, games, torrent clients) may ignore the system one.
proxy.hint.restart: After changing the proxy, some programs need to be restarted.
proxy.hint.pac: Enabled auto-config (PAC) takes precedence over the regular proxy.
proxy.more.store: Microsoft Store apps may not reach 127.0.0.1: allow “loopback” for them (CheckNetIsolation LoopbackExempt).
proxy.more.winhttp: Windows services and some programs use the WinHTTP proxy, not the system one: it can be set with a separate checkbox.
proxy.more.socks: Browsers may interpret a socks=… entry in the system proxy as SOCKS4; for SOCKS5 the HTTP port of the same proxy is more reliable.
proxy.more.loopback: Addresses in the exclusions (for example <local>) go direct; WinINET does not send 127.0.0.1 through a proxy unless <-loopback> is specified.
proxy.out.hive: This user’s settings are not loaded in Windows right now — sign in and try again.
proxy.out.rejected: Windows did not accept the settings.
proxy.out.user_on: System proxy is on for the user.
proxy.out.user_off: System proxy is off for the user.
proxy.out.machine_on: System proxy is on for the whole PC.
proxy.out.machine_off: System proxy is off for the whole PC.
proxy.out.no_previous: There is no previous proxy for the PC: none was on before “Turn off proxy”.
proxy.chk.bad_address: The proxy address cannot be checked.
proxy.chk.partial: does not answer everything ({kind}): {ok} of {total} test addresses, ≈{ms} ms
proxy.chk.refused: the proxy refused the connection (not running?)
proxy.chk.not_http: this is not an HTTP proxy
proxy.chk.auth: the proxy requires a login and password
proxy.chk.closed: the proxy closed the connection without a reply
proxy.chk.not_socks: this is not a SOCKS5 proxy
proxy.chk.socks_no_anon: the SOCKS5 proxy did not accept access without a password
proxy.chk.socks_auth: the SOCKS5 proxy requires a login and password
